map.Base58 把字节串当作一个大整数反复做除法，这样前导的 0x00 字节会丢失: Base58 treats the byte string as one big integer and keeps dividing it, which would lose leading 0x00 bytes. The convention is that each leading zero byte in the original becomes a single '1' character (the first character of the alphabet). Bitcoin addresses beginning with 1 or 3 usually come from a version byte or a leading zero.
